k_env.note: Ambient heat infiltration conductance per building thermal mass. Strictly positive and identified.

k_int.note: Internal heat gain coefficient. Estimated at lower bound (0.0100) and unconstrained 95% CI includes non-positive values due to low daytime plug telemetry excitation variance.

k_ac.note: Direct HVAC cooling temperature reduction rate. Statistically distinct from zero.

h_env.note: Moisture infiltration rate fitted via stage-2 OLS on latent moisture balance. Analytic standard error unavailable; residual variance is high due to lack of direct latent enthalpy sensors.

h_T.note: Empirical linear approximation of Clausius-Clapeyron saturation vapor pressure curve around 24-26°C (-2.35 %RH/°C), not a universal thermodynamic constant.

h_ac.note: Active cooling dehumidification rate fitted via stage-2 moisture balance. Analytic standard error unavailable.

k_win.note: No window state telemetry in CU-BEMS dataset. Assumed based on ASHRAE natural ventilation literature.

h_win.note: No window state telemetry in CU-BEMS dataset. Assumed based on ASHRAE natural ventilation literature.
